---
title: "Configuration"
guide-section: Reference
---

`dastor serve` reads one YAML file. Unknown keys are refused, so a typo fails at start.

```yaml
spool:
  path: /data/das
  index: null
  refresh_seconds: 300
  rules:
    - column: tag
      pattern: "^public"
      allow: ["*"]
users:
  - name: alice
    key_sha256: <digest from dastor new-key>
    groups: [lab]
https: false
limits:
  max_request_bytes: 2147483648
  max_concurrent_loads: 4
  max_tile_bytes: 67108864
  max_view_bytes: 536870912
  max_upload_bytes: 67108864
annotations:
  path: /data/das_annotations
  anonymous_owner: null
```

## spool

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | required | The data directory, indexed recursively. |
| `index` | in the directory | Where DASCore's index of the directory lives, for a read-only data mount. |
| `refresh_seconds` | none | How often to index the directory again; none indexes only at start. |
| `rules` | `[]` | Who may read which files. With none, nothing is visible. |

### rules

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `column` | A column of the spool's contents, such as `tag`, `station` or `source_path` (relative to the directory). |
| `pattern` | A regular expression searched for in the column's text. Anchor it with `^` and `$`. |
| `allow` | A list of who it grants: `*` (everyone, visitors included), `user:*` (every user), `user:<name>`, `group:<name>`. |

A file is visible only when every row of it matches a rule granting the reader. With users and no rule granting `*`, the server is closed to visitors (see [Access control](32-access.qmd)).

## users

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | The user's name. With annotations on, a plain word (letters, digits, `_ . -`), since it names a folder. |
| `key_sha256` | The SHA-256 hex digest of the user's key, from `dastor new-key` or `dastor hash-key`. |
| `groups` | The groups the user is in, for `group:<name>` rules. |

Names and digests must be unique, and no user may be named `*`.

## https

`true` when the pages are served over HTTPS, here or by a proxy which passes them on over HTTP: the sign-in cookie is then always `Secure` and `__Host-`.

## limits

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `max_request_bytes` | 2 GiB | The largest data response, estimated before loading (413 above it). |
| `max_concurrent_loads` | 4 | Patches loading at once across all requests. |
| `max_tile_bytes` | 64 MiB | The most array bytes one viewer tile may read. |
| `max_view_bytes` | 512 MiB | The most the viewer reads for one screen; above it a coarser product stands in. |
| `max_upload_bytes` | 64 MiB | The largest annotation set uploaded as a file. |

## annotations

Optional; turns on the annotation API.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | required | A directory outside the data directory. Sets are kept in it as `<owner>/<name>/`. |
| `anonymous_owner` | none | The owner visitors save as; none refuses their saves. Not allowed on a server closed to visitors. |
